description.value: Milano Coffee is a Vancouver-founded Italian-heritage specialty roaster with over 30 years of West Coast history, operating cafes across BC including this location on Victoria's busy Government Street. The brand has won 15 gold medals from the International Institute of Coffee Tasters for its carefully hand-roasted 100% Arabica blends. Touring cyclists riding through Victoria's historic downtown core will find a well-established independent espresso bar steps from the inner harbour.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (20 spaces) at 70m; rack (12 spaces) at 82m. Total: 32 spaces.
